content:
Solving the forced equations:
\[
3a-2b+c=4,\quad a+2b-3c=-6,\quad 2a-b+2c=2.
\]
From \(a+2b-3c=-6\), we get \(a=-6-2b+3c\). Substitute into the other two equations:
\[
3(-6-2b+3c)-2b+c=4 \implies -4b+5c=11,
\]
\[
2(-6-2b+3c)-b+2c=2 \implies -5b+8c=14.
\]
Solving:
\[
-4b+5c=11,\quad -5b+8c=14
\]
gives \(c=\frac17\), \(b=-\frac{18}{7}\). Then
\[
a=-6-2\left(-\frac{18}{7}\right)+3\left(\frac17\right)=-\frac37.
\]
Thus
\[
2a+b-4c=2\left(-\frac37\right)-\frac{18}{7}-4\left(\frac17\right)
=-\frac{28}{7}=-4.
\]
\[
\boxed{-4}
\]
